story_info.title: Penny's Playtime Water Break
story_info.subtitle: A Story about Staying Hydrated for Play
story_info.moral: Drinking water helps us stay healthy and energetic for play.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

slides.title: A Sunny Play Day
slides.text: Penny Penguin was at Snowy Shores on Saturday. The sun shone bright and the air felt cool. She loved to build big snow castles there. Penny rolled a very large snowball. Then she stacked it high with smaller ones. Her flippers moved quickly, building fast. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she said. She felt strong and happy as she played.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny Penguin starts her fun day building a snow castle at Snowy Shores.

slides.title: Feeling a Little Tired
slides.text: Penny kept playing for a long, long time. She made tall towers and strong castle walls. The sun felt warmer on her black feathers now. Penny started to feel a little bit tired. Her orange beak felt a tiny bit dry inside. She slowed down her building, feeling less zip. "Hmm," Penny thought, "I feel a bit sleepy now."
slides.speaker_notes: Penny starts to feel tired and a bit dry while playing under the warmer sun.

slides.title: Remembering a Healthy Habit
slides.text: Penny stopped playing in the soft snow. She remembered her own happy catchphrase. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she thought. What healthy habit did she forget today? Penny looked at her strong flippers. She thought about all her morning play. "Ah!" Penny suddenly remembered something big. She had not drunk any water all morning!
slides.speaker_notes: Penny realizes she forgot to drink water to stay healthy and energetic.

slides.title: A Cool, Refreshing Drink
slides.text: Penny went quickly to her little snow home. She opened her small blue water bottle with her beak. The water looked so cool and refreshing inside. Penny took a big, long drink, "Gulp, gulp!" Then she took another happy gulp. "Ah," she sighed. That felt so good and fresh! She felt the cool water giving her energy back.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny drinks water and feels the cool refreshment and renewed energy.

slides.title: Happy and Strong Again
slides.text: Penny felt much better now. Her energy came back, hop and skip! She went back to her big snow castle. Penny added the very last snowflake. It was the best castle she had ever built! "Drinking water helps me play all day!" she said happily. Penny smiled, feeling strong and very happy inside.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny finishes her castle, feeling strong and happy, remembering the importance of water.

instagram.caption: Penny Penguin is having the best time building a giant snow castle at Snowy Shores! She's rolling snowballs and stacking them high, full of energy. But after a while, even sporty Penny starts to feel a little tired and her throat feels dry. Can she remember the healthy habit she needs to feel strong again? This sweet story teaches children the importance of drinking water to keep their bodies and minds healthy, even during fun playtime! #Bedtime01Fables #PennyPenguin #KidsHealth #HydrationForKids #StorytimeFun
